blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan on Tuesday urged government officials to protect farmers opposing mining exploration activities in Kasibu, Nueva Vizcaya. According to the senator, government agencies should respect the rights of residents who have maintained barricades for nearly six months to oppose the exploration project of North Luzon Mineral Resources Corp. (NLMRC). “Why do farmers in Kasibu, Nueva Vizcaya have to defend themselves, their land, and their livelihoods against the very authorities who are supposed to protect them?” Pangilinan asked. “Authorities should stand with them — not subject them to violence, arrests, or intimidation,” he added.
